```yaml
name: Build and Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      node-version:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '20'
      os:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'ubuntu-latest'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            arch: darwin-arm64
            toolchain: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            arch: linux-x64-gnu
            toolchain: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

      - name: Cache cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          mkdir -p build
          cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/platformatic-php build/platformatic-php-${{ matrix.arch }}

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: npm-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: build/

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }}

      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: npm-*
          path: build/
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          npm install
          npm test

  bundle:
    needs: [build, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download all build artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: npm-*
          path: build/
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Create release bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p release-bundle
          cp build/* release-bundle/
          cp package.json release-bundle/
          cp README.md release-bundle/
          cp LICENSE release-bundle/
          cp -r scripts/ release-bundle/scripts/
          tar -czf release-bundle.tar.gz -C release-bundle .

      - name: Upload release bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: release-bundle.tar.gz
```
